status: AI-generated radio voices for STORY-RADIO-01 (requested by Alex, 15 Nov 2026). Every transcript is machine-checked word for word; no clip has been listened to or approved by a human yet.
disclosure: Every clip in this manifest is synthetic speech generated with Google Gemini TTS. No human voice recording is used.
processing: None: each WAV is the exact generated master (24 kHz mono PCM16, dry). HandheldRadioPresenter band-limits the voice at runtime (high-pass 300 Hz, low-pass 3400 Hz, distortion 0.12) and adds squelch, key-up and the noise bed.

casting.Orus: Mission Control, Earth and Pad Control (the voice of the approved Clean, Story02 and Departure masters)
casting.Iapetus: the player (YOU): first use in this project, no player voice existed before

supersedes: vo40_mc_rescue_lost_day14 replaces the day-neutral cut vo23_mc_rescue_lost_dayneutral for the Day-14 announcement. The cut and the approved vo23 master stay in the repository, unbound.
